comment: What this house adopted from junghanacs.com's engine shelf, in machine-readable form. scripts/verify-engine reads this file; eval/engine/README.md is the prose beside it. The shelf publishes immutable releases, so drift can only mean two things: the bytes here stopped matching the hash the shelf published, or the shelf published a newer release this house has not looked at.

modules.callSites: not listed here on purpose — scripts/verify-engine finds every reference to a claim-v1.<sha256>.js path in the tree and requires all of them to be this hash, so re-vendoring cannot leave one page behind

notAdopted.why: cell-v1 is this house's own eval/eval.js as it stood on 2026-09-12, frozen upstream as the compatibility baseline. The house runs the moving version, not the frozen copy, so there is nothing to vendor.
